answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-and-slash jury verdicts: every agent locks a refundable stake before voting, and rotating juries cross-check flagged identities. A lying juror loses part of that stake to the reporters, so attacking an island of honest agents costs an attacker more than any reward it could win. Reputation accrues like slow saffron - expensive to farm - while forged history crumbles like shale under peer cross-examination.
